findings.issue: Arbitrary-dependence union-bound plus Bonferroni guarantee additionally requires fixed families/counts, or p-values valid conditional on the realized family/count. Complete observed attempts alone is insufficient under score-adaptive stopping. A random realized m can make m*p_min anti-conservative even when each trial p-value is marginally valid.
findings.required_change: Qualify no-dependence guarantee by a fixed family of attempts and owners (or conditional validity given counts); identify observed-count sensitivity as descriptive when submission stopping is score-adaptive. Add the count-selection caveat to limitations.
findings.owner_response: Report agent patched sections2.3 and5 and regenerated both sources; final read-only review confirms resolution.
findings.analytical_example: With one owner and independent uniform null p-values, stop at m=1 if p1<=alpha, otherwise m=2. Then realized-m union rejection probability is alpha+(1-alpha)*alpha/2>alpha.
findings.resolution: Section2.3 now explicitly restricts the no-dependence guarantee to a fixed attempt/owner family with valid single-submission p-values, and labels score-adaptive observed-count results descriptive unless validity holds conditional on observed family/counts. Section5 now explicitly identifies random realized-count and adaptive-stopping limitations. Confirmed in Markdown plus both generated author variants.
